[PREFERENCE] User is interested in theme parks and rollercoasters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Orlando is referred to as the theme park capital of the world.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended theme parks include Walt Disney World, Universal Orlando Resort, SeaWorld Orlando, and LEGOLAND Florida.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Walt Disney World consists of four parks: Magic Kingdom, Epcot, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Universal Orlando Resort includes Universal Studios Florida and Universal's Islands of Adventure.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SeaWorld Orlando is described as a marine-life theme park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] LEGOLAND Florida is designed for younger kids.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended rollercoasters include SheiKra, Mako, Kraken, Manta, Hollywood Rip Ride Rockit, Incredible Hulk Coaster, Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith, and Expedition Everest - Legend of the Forbidden Mountain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for visiting include planning during the off-season, considering park-hopper tickets, taking breaks, and not missing evening shows.  
[EVENT] User inquired about Halloween Horror Nights at Universal Studios Florida.  
[PREFERENCE] User loved the Halloween Horror Nights event at Universal Studios Hollywood.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Halloween Horror Nights at Universal Studios Florida runs on select nights from mid-September to early November.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The event features haunts, scare zones, live shows, and select attractions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Florida's HHN features original haunts, larger scale experiences, unique scare zones, and roaming hordes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended tips include arriving early, considering a Front of the Line pass, wearing comfortable clothing, and taking breaks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Insider's tip includes checking the Universal Orlando Resort website for special events.
